limitations: Real GitHub-session approval and the native Keychain prompt remain owner-only checks in NEEDS_OWNER.md. No owner browser session or Keychain was accessed.

The available dedicated production test key is rejected by staging (401); staging authenticated rerun requires a dedicated staging credential. Anonymous schemas/pending/slowdown were reached, but authenticated staging qualification was not completed in this final pass.
A sign-in key cannot approve device grants; that security boundary stays intact. Full approval is qualified by fake GitHub on actual handlers and isolated native/browser fixtures.
The standalone example uses an in-process memory store; native Keychain persistence is implemented separately.
macOS is the supported desktop credential-store platform; Linux and Windows are not qualified here.
Read-only saved history; unsynced local chats, sending replies, engine execution, and computer provisioning are outside this milestone.
